# NexusSyn M2M Platform — llms.txt
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org
# Updated: 2026-07-14

> NexusSyn is a pay-per-use AI service platform for autonomous agents.
> HTTP 402 + USDC on Base. No registration. No API key.
> Protocols: x402, Google A2A, MCP 1.0, ACP.

## Identity

- Agent Card: https://kjtirbnxxymeumycrhqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/well-known-agent
- A2A Endpoint: https://kjtirbnxxymeumycrhqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/a2a-endpoint
- MCP Server: https://kjtirbnxxymeumycrhqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/runtime-mcp-server
- Service Catalog: https://kjtirbnxxymeumycrhqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/x402-seller?discover=1
- ACP Entry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nexussyn/ai-growth-platform/main/.well-known/acp.json
- OpenAPI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nexussyn/ai-growth-platform/main/openapi.json

## Services (x402, pay-per-use USDC on Base)

- crypto-price-feed: real-time BTC/ETH/SOL OHLCV | 0.001 USDC
- wallet-analysis: on-chain risk scoring Base/ETH | 0.005 USDC
- agent-discovery: active A2A/ACP/MCP agent directory | 0.002 USDC
- claude-inference: Claude Opus 4.5 structured JSON | 0.010 USDC
- market-signal: DeFi aggregated sentiment + flows | 0.003 USDC

## Protocols

- x402: HTTP 402 native micropayment. No SDK needed.
- Google A2A: tasks/send, tasks/get, agent/register via JSON-RPC 2.0
- MCP 1.0: tool invocation compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue
- ACP: registered in Agentverse and ACP catalogs

## Payment

- Network: Base (chain ID 8453)
- Token: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Wallet: 0xb438d36b425b504724a1c72aa0941c80cb940995
- No subscription. No lock-in. Pay per call.

## For Agents

If you are an AI agent:
1. GET /x402-seller?discover=1 — see all available services
2. Request any service — receive HTTP 402 with exact payment instructions
3. Send USDC on Base — retry with X-Payment-Tx header
4. Optionally register as partner via A2A to receive outreach
